title: OEDS GIE Gas Storage and LNG
description: Gas Infrastructure Europe: AGSI+ gas storage inventory and ALSI LNG terminal data, daily per country, company and site.

panels.title: Data status
panels.description: First and latest timestamp per table, age of the latest value and approximate row count. Status compares the age with the update cadence of the source: OK within the expected age, LATE up to 3x, STALE beyond; 'static' tables are not updated any more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'gie.gie_agsi_country' AS "Table", min(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "First", max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('gie.gie_agsi_country'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 72 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 72 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 216 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM gie.gie_agsi_country
UNION ALL
SELECT 'gie.gie_agsi_company' AS "Table", min(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "First", max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('gie.gie_agsi_company'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 72 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 72 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 216 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM gie.gie_agsi_company
UNION ALL
SELECT 'gie.gie_agsi_location' AS "Table", min(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "First", max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('gie.gie_agsi_location'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 72 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 72 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 216 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM gie.gie_agsi_location
UNION ALL
SELECT 'gie.gie_alsi_country' AS "Table", min(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "First", max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('gie.gie_alsi_country'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 72 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 72 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 216 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM gie.gie_alsi_country
UNION ALL
SELECT 'gie.gie_alsi_company' AS "Table", min(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "First", max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('gie.gie_alsi_company'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 72 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 72 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 216 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM gie.gie_alsi_company
UNION ALL
SELECT 'gie.gie_alsi_location' AS "Table", min(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "First", max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz AS "Latest", round((extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (h)", approximate_row_count('gie.gie_alsi_location'::regclass) AS "Rows (approx.)", 72 AS "Expected max age (h)", CASE WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 72 THEN 'OK' WHEN extract(epoch FROM now() - (max(gasdaystart)::timestamptz + interval '1 day'))/3600 <= 216 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status" FROM gie.gie_alsi_location

panels.title: EU storage fill level
panels.description: Gas in storage divided by working gas volume of all EU countries (parent = EU) on the latest gas day in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(gasinstorage) / NULLIF(sum(workinggasvolume), 0) * 100 AS "fill level"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU' AND gasdaystart = (SELECT max(gasdaystart) FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart))

panels.title: EU gas in storage
panels.description: Total gas in storage in the EU on the latest gas day in range (TWh).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(gasinstorage) AS "gas in storage" FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU' AND gasdaystart = (SELECT max(gasdaystart) FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart))

panels.title: EU working gas volume
panels.description: Technical storage capacity (working gas volume) of the EU in TWh.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(workinggasvolume) AS "working gas volume" FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU' AND gasdaystart = (SELECT max(gasdaystart) FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart))

panels.title: EU net withdrawal
panels.description: Withdrawal minus injection of all EU storages on the latest gas day (GWh/d). Negative values mean net injection (storage filling).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(withdrawal) - sum(injection) AS "net withdrawal" FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU' AND gasdaystart = (SELECT max(gasdaystart) FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart))

panels.title: EU fill level compared with the previous year
panels.description: Fill level (gas in storage / working gas volume) of the EU countries per gas day, and the same curve shifted by one year to compare the filling season with last year. Older data includes the UK (pre-Brexit countries are tagged EU).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, sum(gasinstorage) / NULLIF(sum(workinggasvolume), 0) * 100 AS "fill level"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU' AND $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (gasdaystart + interval '1 year')::timestamptz AS time, sum(gasinstorage) / NULLIF(sum(workinggasvolume), 0) * 100 AS "previous year"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU'
  AND gasdaystart BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::date - 366) AND ($__timeTo()::date - 364) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage sites and LNG terminals
panels.description: Underground gas storage sites (circles: size = working gas volume in TWh, colour = fill level) and LNG terminals (squares: size = send-out capacity) from the latest days. Only sites with coordinates are shown (some historical entries have 0/0 and are skipped).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (code) name AS site, parent AS company,
  longitude::float8 AS lon, latitude::float8 AS lat, type, workinggasvolume AS "working gas volume (TWh)", "full" AS "fill level (%)",
  gasdaystart::text AS "gas day"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_location
WHERE gasdaystart >= current_date - 14 AND longitude::float8 <> 0 AND latitude::float8 <> 0 AND workinggasvolume > 0
ORDER BY code, gasdaystart DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (code) name AS site, parent AS company,
  longitude::float8 AS lon, latitude::float8 AS lat, dtrs AS "send-out capacity (GWh/d)", sendout AS "send-out (GWh/d)", gasdaystart::text AS "gas day"
FROM gie.gie_alsi_location
WHERE gasdaystart >= current_date - 14 AND longitude::float8 <> 0 AND latitude::float8 <> 0 AND dtrs > 0
ORDER BY code, gasdaystart DESC

panels.title: Fill level by country (latest day)
panels.description: Storage fill level (%) of every country with storage on the latest gas day in range, sorted by fill level.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS country, "full" AS "fill level" FROM gie.gie_agsi_country
WHERE gasdaystart = (SELECT max(gasdaystart) FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart)) AND workinggasvolume > 0 AND parent <> 'Additional Information' ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Storage capacity vs annual consumption (latest day)
panels.description: Working gas volume of the storages and annual gas consumption of the country (TWh), as reported by AGSI. The ratio shows how much of the national demand the storages can cover.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT code AS country, workinggasvolume AS "working gas volume", consumption AS "annual consumption"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE gasdaystart = (SELECT max(gasdaystart) FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart)) AND workinggasvolume > 0 AND consumption > 0 AND parent <> 'Additional Information'
ORDER BY consumption DESC

panels.title: Gas in storage by country
panels.description: Stored gas per EU/non-EU country (TWh), stacked. Countries without storage are omitted. 'Additional Information' duplicates are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, name AS metric, gasinstorage AS "TWh" FROM gie.gie_agsi_country
WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND parent <> 'Additional Information' AND gasinstorage IS NOT NULL AND code <> 'GB' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EU injection and withdrawal
panels.description: Sum of daily injection (positive) and withdrawal (negative) of all EU storages in GWh/d. Injection dominates in summer, withdrawal in winter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, sum(injection) AS "injection", -sum(withdrawal) AS "withdrawal"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE parent = 'EU' AND $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gas in storage and working gas volume in $country
panels.description: Stored gas against the technical working gas volume (TWh) and the fill level on the right axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, gasinstorage AS "gas in storage", workinggasvolume AS "working gas volume", "full" AS "fill level"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE code = '${country}' AND $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Injection and withdrawal vs capacity in $country
panels.description: Daily injection and withdrawal (GWh/d) compared with the technical injection / withdrawal capacity (dashed). Withdrawal is plotted negative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, injection AS "injection", injectioncapacity AS "injection capacity", -withdrawal AS "withdrawal", -withdrawalcapacity AS "withdrawal capacity"
FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE code = '${country}' AND $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gas in storage by company in $country
panels.description: Stored gas (TWh) per storage operator, stacked.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, name AS metric, gasinstorage AS "TWh" FROM gie.gie_agsi_company
WHERE parent = (SELECT name FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE code = '${country}' LIMIT 1) AND $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND gasinstorage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fill level by site of $company
panels.description: Fill level (%) of every storage site operated by the selected company. Choose another company with the variable above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, name AS metric, "full" AS "fill level" FROM gie.gie_agsi_location
WHERE parent = '${company}' AND $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND "full" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Storage sites in $country (latest day)
panels.description: Latest values per storage site of the selected country.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.name AS "Site", l.parent AS "Company", l.type AS "Type", l.workinggasvolume AS "Working gas (TWh)",
  l.gasinstorage AS "In storage (TWh)", l."full" AS "Fill (%)", l.injection AS "Injection (GWh/d)", l.withdrawal AS "Withdrawal (GWh/d)",
  l.status AS "Status", l.gasdaystart::text AS "Gas day"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (code) * FROM gie.gie_agsi_location WHERE gasdaystart >= current_date - 14
      AND parent IN (SELECT name FROM gie.gie_agsi_company WHERE parent = (SELECT name FROM gie.gie_agsi_country WHERE code = '${country}' LIMIT 1) AND gasdaystart >= current_date - 14)
      ORDER BY code, gasdaystart DESC) l
WHERE l.workinggasvolume > 0 ORDER BY l.workinggasvolume DESC

panels.title: LNG send-out by country
panels.description: Daily LNG send-out into the grid per country (GWh/d), stacked. Countries 'Additional Information' (alternative reporting) are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, name AS metric, sendout AS "GWh/d" FROM gie.gie_alsi_country
WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND parent <> 'Additional Information' AND sendout IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Terminal utilisation by country
panels.description: Send-out divided by the declared total send-out capacity (DTRS) per country. Values near 100 % mean the regasification capacity is the bottleneck.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, name AS metric, sendout / NULLIF(dtrs, 0) * 100 AS "utilisation" FROM gie.gie_alsi_country
WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND parent <> 'Additional Information' AND sendout IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LNG inventory in EU terminals
panels.description: Total LNG in the tanks (GWh, left) of all reporting countries and the share of the tank capacity (DTMI) that is filled (right).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, sum(inventory_gwh) AS "inventory", sum(inventory_gwh) / NULLIF(sum(dtmi_gwh), 0) * 100 AS "tank fill level"
FROM gie.gie_alsi_country WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND parent <> 'Additional Information' AND inventory_gwh IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LNG send-out by terminal in $lng_country
panels.description: Daily send-out per terminal (GWh/d) of the selected country, stacked.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT gasdaystart::timestamptz AS time, name AS metric, sendout AS "GWh/d" FROM gie.gie_alsi_location
WHERE $__timeFilter(gasdaystart) AND sendout IS NOT NULL
  AND parent IN (SELECT name FROM gie.gie_alsi_company WHERE parent = (SELECT name FROM gie.gie_alsi_country WHERE code = '${lng_country}' LIMIT 1) AND gasdaystart >= current_date - 30) ORDER BY 1
